reference_sql:
WITH base AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2025 and account with MRR at the end of the quarter before, with that MRR in euros
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS quarter_start, m.account_id, m.mrr_eur
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month IN (DATE '2024-12-01', DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2025-06-01', DATE '2025-09-01')
), lost AS (
  -- one row per account and quarter of 2025 with a churn event: the MRR it lost, in euros
  SELECT e.account_id, CAST(date_trunc('quarter', e.event_date) AS DATE) AS quarter_start, SUM(-e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS lost_mrr
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type = 'churn' AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY e.account_id, CAST(date_trunc('quarter', e.event_date) AS DATE)
)
SELECT b.quarter_start, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start,
  COUNT(l.account_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS logo_churn_rate,
  COALESCE(SUM(l.lost_mrr), 0) / SUM(b.mrr_eur) AS mrr_churn_rate
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN lost l ON l.account_id = b.account_id AND l.quarter_start = b.quarter_start
GROUP BY b.quarter_start

WITH base AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2025 and account with MRR at the end of the quarter before, with that MRR in euros
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS quarter_start, m.account_id, m.mrr_eur
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month IN (DATE '2024-12-01', DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2025-06-01', DATE '2025-09-01')
), churn_events AS (
  -- one row per churn event of 2025, with its lost MRR in euros
  SELECT e.account_id, e.event_date, -e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit AS lost_mrr
  FROM subscription_events e
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  WHERE e.event_type = 'churn' AND e.event_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
), per_account AS (
  -- one row per quarter and base account: whether it churned and the MRR it lost
  SELECT b.quarter_start, b.account_id, b.mrr_eur,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(c.account_id) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS churned,
    COALESCE(SUM(c.lost_mrr), 0) AS lost_mrr
  FROM base b
  LEFT JOIN churn_events c ON c.account_id = b.account_id
    AND c.event_date >= b.quarter_start AND c.event_date < b.quarter_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH
  GROUP BY b.quarter_start, b.account_id, b.mrr_eur
)
SELECT quarter_start, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start, AVG(churned) AS logo_churn_rate, SUM(lost_mrr) / SUM(mrr_eur) AS mrr_churn_rate
FROM per_account
GROUP BY quarter_start

WITH base AS (
  -- one row per quarter of 2025 and account with MRR at the end of the quarter before, with that MRR in euros
  SELECT CAST(m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE) AS quarter_start, m.account_id, m.mrr_eur
  FROM mrr_monthly m
  WHERE m.month IN (DATE '2024-12-01', DATE '2025-03-01', DATE '2025-06-01', DATE '2025-09-01')
)
SELECT b.quarter_start, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM subscription_events e WHERE e.account_id = b.account_id AND e.event_type = 'churn'
    AND e.event_date >= b.quarter_start AND e.event_date < b.quarter_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH)) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS logo_churn_rate,
  COALESCE(SUM((SELECT SUM(-e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) FROM subscription_events e
    JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
    JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
    WHERE e.account_id = b.account_id AND e.event_type = 'churn'
      AND e.event_date >= b.quarter_start AND e.event_date < b.quarter_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH)), 0) / SUM(b.mrr_eur) AS mrr_churn_rate
FROM base b
GROUP BY b.quarter_start

solver.query:
WITH quarters AS (
  SELECT CAST(m AS DATE) AS quarter_start FROM generate_series(DATE '2025-01-01', DATE '2025-10-01', INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AS t(m)
), base AS (
  SELECT q.quarter_start, r.account_id, r.mrr_eur
  FROM quarters q JOIN mrr_monthly r ON r.month = CAST(q.quarter_start - INTERVAL 1 MONTH AS DATE)
), lost AS (
  SELECT b.quarter_start, e.account_id, SUM(-e.mrr_delta_local * f.eur_per_unit) AS lost_eur
  FROM base b
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.account_id = b.account_id AND e.event_type = 'churn'
    AND e.event_date >= b.quarter_start AND e.event_date < CAST(b.quarter_start + INTERVAL 3 MONTH AS DATE)
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  JOIN fx_rates f ON f.currency = s.currency AND f.rate_date = DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY b.quarter_start, e.account_id
)
SELECT b.quarter_start, COUNT(*) AS accounts_at_start,
  COUNT(l.account_id) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS logo_churn_rate,
  COALESCE(SUM(l.lost_eur), 0) / SUM(b.mrr_eur) AS mrr_churn_rate
FROM base b LEFT JOIN lost l ON l.quarter_start = b.quarter_start AND l.account_id = b.account_id
GROUP BY b.quarter_start
